_comment: v9: v8 label space on the v9 BioProject-disjoint partition. Four classification heads, no regression -- sample_age/latitude/longitude were dropped (see PROJECT.md section 3) and sample_type is out of v7 onward. Features come from matrix_v9_train, whose vocabulary is built from TRAINING RUNS ONLY (R3.4); val and test are projected onto it.

class_imbalance._comment: Replaces v7's inverse-frequency class weights, which taught the net a balanced posterior that was then argmaxed on an imbalanced split -- the 158-of-235 Homo sapiens runs predicted Papio hamadryas. tau=1 is parameter-free and needs no post-hoc correction fitted on a held-out split. class_weights must stay null: MultiTaskLoss raises if both are set.

masking._comment: Absent labels are masked, not encoded as a class. Environmental runs have no community_type/sample_host; host runs have no feature; material classes under 3 training runs are masked; 12 McDonough2018 runs have conflicting labels masked per target.
